claims.statement: Only the customer-records app exhibits authorization failures; other apps operate normally, indicating app-specific rather than identity-wide or network-wide issue
All support agents reporting the issue are among the 214 whose roles were changed overnight, indicating perfect correlation between role change and access loss

next_action.rationale: Sampled request traces from the customer-records app will reveal what entitlement version/cache state the app is consulting when it denies access. This will confirm whether the app is indeed serving stale cached entitlements (e.g., version 41 referenced in contractor log) or if the failure is happening at a different stage (e.g., ID provider claims, cache bypass, etc.). This is the highest-information diagnostic step: it produces concrete evidence to either confirm the stale cache hypothesis or rule it out and redirect investigation.
